abstraction_level: logical (Menzel) - every parameter is a [min, max] range
scope_warning: actors are 360-degree annotation facts, NOT CAM_FRONT facts. Only 28.46% of nuScenes annotations fall in the front camera and 444 of 850 scenes contain a class it never sees. `n_in_camera` is provided per actor so the front-camera subset stays visible (R25/F-025).

scenography.lighting.source: log.logfile local capture hour, split at 18:00
scenography.lighting.validation: 100.0% agreement with the human 'night' keyword on 850/850 scenes

parameters.road_extent_m.source: bounding-box diagonal of the ego trajectory
parameters.road_extent_m.caveat: a PROXY for the slide's 'road range size'. It measures how far the ego travelled, not how large the road is, and collapses to ~0 on the 65 scenes where the ego never moves.

parameters.pedestrian_speed_mps.bound: values above 3.0 m/s excluded and counted, not clipped (R2/R11)

absent_fields.lane_count: The slide names '3 lines [lanes] road'. No cached table carries a lane COUNT. It is derivable from the map's lane STRtree, but `road_block` - the layer that would carry it - is DEGENERATE ON TWO MAPS: all 676 singapore-queenstown records and all 387 singapore-hollandvillage records point at a single whole-map polygon (7,748 and 4,851 nodes). That is 200 of 850 scenes, 23.5%. D-019/F-020 recorded only queenstown.
absent_fields.weather: 19.4% of human descriptions say rain; nuScenes has no weather annotation and no deterministic proxy was found. PEGASUS Layer 5 is therefore PARTLY covered by `lighting`, not covered.
absent_fields.pegasus_layer_6: V2X / digital information is absent from the dataset entirely.
